title: Have grand theories of consciousness earned their keep?
title_zh: 意识大理论真的值得吗？
abstract: The recent controversies surrounding theories of consciousness invite a more fundamental reassessment of their scientific value. We argue that the field's most transformative advances have been driven by rigorous empirical research rather than overarching theoretical frameworks and that future progress may depend on returning to that tradition.
abstract_zh: 近期关于意识理论的争议促使人们对其科学价值进行更根本的重新评估。我们认为，该领域最具变革性的进展是由严谨的实证研究推动的，而非宏观的理论框架；未来的进步可能取决于回归这一传统。
